description: This file contains the PHP class 'Voucher' which is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines methods for handling voucher totals, including calculating the total, confirming, and unconfirming voucher use in orders.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents the Voucher total model in OpenCart, responsible for calculating voucher discounts and managing voucher usage within an order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total discount contribution of a voucher to the order, and updates session data accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms a voucher, adding a record to voucher history related to an order.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Reverses voucher confirmation, deleting related voucher history for an order.
